_README: Human-labeled from SOURCE (never from parser output). CheckoutView.total calls self.strategy.calculate() on an UNTYPED receiver; two modules define calculate(): billing.pricing.PriceCalc and shipping.rates.RateCalc. Source alone cannot tell which one runs. Under ADR-0004 (M1.12.a) an ambiguous call gets NO edge — it is recorded in unresolved_calls (reason ambiguous) — so neither calculate() edge may exist. The two import-scoped edges must still resolve.
_di_resolution_note: History: this fixture once gauged A-3 call-graph community narrowing, which picked PriceCalc.calculate because the caller's file was wired into billing. ADR-0004 retired that heuristic: graph locality is not evidence of the runtime target, so the call is ambiguous and both edges are forbidden.
